goal: Allow wallet users to fund, create, and fee-bump transactions paying to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Improves recipient privacy and eliminates address reuse for Bitcoin Core wallet transactions
reviewability: Needs rebase against master, but reviewing the logic now is worthwhile because the conflict is mechanical
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa)
Unaddressed objection: MSVC compilation failure in wallet model, no author reply (Yudis-bit)
Contested objection: anchor input filtering aborts sends with fees subtracted from outputs (Yudis-bit)
Unresolved concern: EraseSpRecipients risks permanent recipient loss if original tx mines (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it brings silent payment sending support to Bitcoin Core wallets and RPC endpoints
Gives users sender-side receiver privacy and addresses reuse issues without external tooling
Lays necessary groundwork for broader silent payment adoption across the project
